title: India–UK CETA comes into force: The IP framework shaping a new era of Bilateral Trade
description: The entry into force of the India–United Kingdom Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the Double Contribution Convention (DCC) on July 15, 2026 marks a defining moment in India–UK economic relations.
